Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather of Richard Burke, 4th Earl of Clanricarde, was Ulick Burke, 1st Earl of Clanricarde, based on an erroneous assumption about primogeniture. The Planner failed to verify the lineage through reliable sources and overlooked the fact that Ulick Burke, 3rd Earl of Clanricarde, was the son of Richard Burke, 2nd Earl of Clanricarde, as confirmed earlier in the WebSurfer's results. This led to the wrong identification of the paternal grandfather.
